text:
Liam: Heads-up: firing the press + analyst webinar plan. Proposed embargo Tue May 9 09:00-13:00 PT. Need press kit, analyst handout, and lead-routing for webinar signups. Who can own each?

Sofia: I can own invites + landing page. Will build HubSpot form and tag inbound leads with "launch-webinar" + "analyst" where appropriate. Need copy for form and a short privacy note.

Zara: I'll assemble the press kit (one-pager, benchmark summary, screenshots) and a 90s demo clip. Will add a separate analyst appendix with test harness details.

Tom (Legal): Legal checks: final quote text needs 24h review. Privacy note for the form must reference data processing and opt-in for follow-ups. No comparative phrasing without baseline defined.

Mika (PR): For press outreach, we need a single-sentence soundbite and a 2-line email opener. Also recommend an analyst-only Q&A after the public webinar (30 min).

Liam: Draft soundbite attempt: "Redwood Inference reduced median p95 latency by ~25% and cut per-token cost by ~1.8x in our benchmark suite." Tom please edit.

Tom (Legal): Edit suggested: "Redwood Inference demonstrated a ~25% median p95 latency improvement and an approximately 1.8x reduction in per-token cost versus our internal baseline in benchmark runs." Send final to me Mon EOD.

Sofia: HubSpot form fields: name, org, email, role, use-case, opt-in checkbox. Routing: tag journalists -> Mika, analysts -> Liam, leads -> SDR queue ("launch-inbound"). Anyone object?

Mika (PR): Good. Also create a media-pass link (password-protected) for embargoed assets, expire link at embargo lift. Please include a small FAQ for embargo rules.

Zara: Tech appendix (short): "Benchmarks executed on 8xA100 nodes, seq len 1024, continuous batching + KV cache; metric = median p95 across 10k samples. Scripts & configs in the factcheck doc." Adding raw numbers now.

Liam: Plan for webinar: 20-min product demo, 10-min benchmark walkthrough, 15-min public Q&A, then 30-min analyst-only Q&A. Dry-run tomorrow 11:00 PT. RSVP: Zara, Tom, Mika?

Zara: RSVP yes for dry-run. Will bring the 90s clip.

Tom (Legal): I'll join for the quote review at dry-run. Reminder: flag vendor models or third-party datasets explicitly in the factcheck doc.

Sofia: I'll wire up the HubSpot form + landing page and post link here when ready. Also adding webhook to create a ticket in SDR queue for inbound press leads.

Mika (PR): Outreach timeline: embargo email to vetted press + analysts 24h before window opens; follow-up reminders at T-6h and T-1h. Will craft email copy after quote is final.

Liam: Final checklist: Sofia - landing + lead routing; Zara - press kit + 90s clip + appendix; Tom - final quote sign-off by Mon EOD; Mika - outreach copy + embargo email list. Add anything else to the factcheck doc. :thumbsup:
